articles.summary: Independent Bank Corp. (Nasdaq Global Select Market: INDB), parent of Rockland Trust Company, announced the following details for its third quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call: Earnings Release : Thursday, October 15, 2026, after the market close Conference Call (held via Webcast): Friday, October 16, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Time How to Join Webcast: Participants may join the webcast by registering prior to the call via this link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/687573325 A replay of the webcast will be made available on the Company’s website at https://indb.rocklandtrust.com by selecting Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call. The webcast replay will be available until October 16, 2027. Independent Bank Corp. (NASDAQ Global Select Market: INDB) is the holding company for Rockland Trust Company, a full-service commercial bank headquartered in Massachusetts.
